description: Returns the signed-in account's images, newest first, one page at a time (pass `cursor` from the previous `next_cursor` while `has_more` is true). WHEN: the user asks what they have made, or you need an image from an earlier session, for example to pass its `url` into `generate_video` as a start frame. It is the whole library, including images made in the web app.

cursor.description: The previous response's `next_cursor`. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: How many to return, 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.

name: list_images
title: List the account's AI images
